source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.3 with Figs. 4.9 and 4.10 (PDF 78-79).

blocks.text: Zameen ke ird-gird ki woh jagah jahan us ki gravitational force kisi body (jism) par lagti hai, gravitational field kehlati hai. Jab cheez ko gravitational field mein hilaya jaye to gravitational force work karti hai. Agar displacement gravitational force ki direction (simt) mein (neeche) ho to work positive hai. Agar displacement gravitational force ke khilaf (oopar) ho to work negative kehlata hai.

Gravitational force ki ek dilchasp property (khoobi) hai: cheez ko ek jagah se doosri jagah le jayein to gravitational force ka work is baat par depend nahi karta ke kaun sa rasta (path) liya gaya. Aayein isay dekhein.

blocks.alt: Zameen par point A aur oonchai h par platform par point B. Path 1 zameen ke saath A se D aur phir D se oopar B tak; Path 2 A se oopar C aur C se B tak; Path 3 A se B tak mura rasta. Path 3 par cheez ka weight (wazan) mg neeche lagta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.9: Gravitational field mein cheez A se B tak teen raston se (kitab ki Figure 4.9 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Maan lein m mass ki cheez ko constant speed se point A se B tak alag alag raston se le jaya jata hai (Fig. 4.9). Yahan gravitational force cheez ke weight mg ke barabar hai.

Path 1 (ADB) par gravitational force ka work do hisson mein baant sakte hain. AD par work zero hai, kyun ke weight mg is raste par perpendicular (90° par) hai. DB par work (−mgh) hai, kyun ke mg ki direction displacement ke ulat hai, yani θ = 180°. Is liye path 1 se A se B tak work:
Path 2 (ACB) lein: AC par work bhi (−mgh) hai, aur CB par work zero hai (yeh horizontal hai). Is liye:

Ab path 3 lein, jo mura hua (curved) hai. Sochein ke yeh rasta bohat chhote horizontal aur vertical steps (qadmon) se bana hai (Fig. 4.10). Horizontal steps par koi work nahi hota, kyun ke wahan mg displacement par perpendicular hai. Gravity sirf vertical steps par work karti hai. Oopar ko positive lein to gravity ki force har step par −mg (neeche ki taraf) hai, is liye har vertical step par work −mgΔy hai. Jahan rasta oopar jata hai wahan Δy positive aur jahan neeche jata hai wahan negative hai; sab Δy mil kar h bante hain. Is liye:

blocks.alt: Smooth (hamwar) mura hua rasta A se uthta hai, crest (chotti) A se guzar kar dip (gehrai) B tak utarta hai aur phir A se oonchai h par B tak jata hai. Chhote horizontal aur vertical steps curve ke saath hain; pehle delta y1, delta y2 aur aakhri delta yn. x-y nishan directions dikhata hai, aur A se dashed lakeer h ki base (neeche ki lakeer) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.10: Smooth rasta bohat hi chhoti (infinitesimal) x aur y displacements ki series se badla ja sakta hai. Work sirf y displacements ke doran hota hai (kitab ki Figure 4.10 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke “mg negative nahi, positive hai, lekin sab Δy negative hain”. Yeh wajah ulti chhapi hai. Sahi yeh hai: oopar ko positive lein to gravity ki force har step par −mg hai, aur Δy₁ + Δy₂ + … + Δyₙ = h. Is liye W_AB = −mgh, jo kitab ka jawab hai.

blocks.latex: \text{Kyun ke}\quad \Delta y_1 + \Delta y_2 + \Delta y_3 + \dots + \Delta y_n = h
blocks.text_alt: Kyun ke   Δy₁ + Δy₂ + Δy₃ + …… + Δyₙ = h

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Horizontal steps par mg displacement par perpendicular hai, is liye wahan work zero. Sirf vertical steps Δy ginte hain, aur sab Δy jor kar kul oonchai h banti hai. Kitab beech ki crest (chotti) ko bhi A aur dip (gehrai) ko bhi B kehti hai: yeh woh hissa hai jahan body neeche aati hai (text ka 'segment AB'); shuru wala A aur aakhri B alag hain.
AB raste par kul work phir bhi (−mgh) hai. Is discussion (behas) se result yeh nikla:

blocks.title: Path independence (raste se azaad hona)
blocks.text: Gravitational force ka work is baat se independent (azaad) hai ke kaun sa rasta liya gaya.

Kya aap prove (sabit) kar sakte hain ke band raste (closed path), jaise ACBA ya ADBA (Fig. 4.9), par gravitational force ka work zero hai? (Ishara: A se B tak −mgh, aur B se wapas A tak +mgh; jor zero.)

blocks.title: Conservative force
blocks.text: Agar kisi force ka do points ke darmiyan cheez le jane ka work raste se azaad ho, ya band raste par us ka work zero ho, to woh force conservative force kehlati hai.
Jaisa upar dekha, gravitational force conservative force hai. Conservative force ki aur misalein electrostatic force aur elastic spring force hain.
